Connect your job

Send a check-in after your job succeeds. The next scheduled check marks it up. If no success arrives within the scheduled time (0 2 * * *, America/New_York) plus 15 min grace, a scheduled check marks it down. Until the first success, it stays Unknown. A private runner must be running.
